reuse.why: Replaces three copy-pasted category queries and setZero's ad-hoc query with one helper used by every month-wide action; the per-action income/tracking check is left repeated in each action.

duplication.why: The diff removes three duplicated SQL blocks and introduces no new copies.

placement.why: The selection helper sits in budget/actions.ts next to getBudgetData and the actions that use it.

scope.why: Only the category selection of month-wide actions and their tests change; single-category actions are untouched.

maintainability.why: One documented selection function owns the eligibility rule; copyPreviousMonth's set-membership lookup alongside getBudgetData's now-unused hidden columns is a small wrinkle.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All five month-wide actions call getMonthWideCategories

one_place.where: getMonthWideCategories in server/budget/actions.ts, used by copyPreviousMonth, setZero, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg and set12MonthAvg
